screen: /connected/snapshot (catalogue issues), a run whose handoff file cannot be read
title: When a pinned context or delivery file cannot be read, the catalogue issue text carries the error's message, which for an OSError holds the server's absolute path, and /connected/snapshot sends it to the browser.
expected: README ruling R3 and the schema: a leaked path is High and always repaired; C1-001 (T01) removes the workspace path from the same response.
actual: src/deploy_workflow/credit_os_catalogue.py:219-220 and :416-417 append f"... ({error})" to issues; an OSError's text names the file's absolute path.
probe: found by repair-1's T01/T02 review (2026-11-17); the T01 follow-up test is the probe
suggested_change: Name the error kind (type(error).__name__), never the message, in catalogue issue text.

screen: Submit with a hand-built module list holding CP-8
title: A hand-built module list holding CP-8 passes the server's module check at Submit and is refused by the launcher at launch.
expected: A module list the launcher refuses is refused at Submit.
actual: CP-8 is in cpos_launch.METHODS, so the Submit check accepts it; the launcher refuses CP-8 in --modules. The page never sends CP-8.
suggested_change: none: parked (an input the page never sends)

screen: Teams run cards (finished, started, stopped, day digest) for a run with an explicit module list
title: The Teams cards count CP-MODEL as a module, so a run that finished every requested module reads '13/14 modules'; T02 makes such runs reachable.
actual: src/deploy_workflow/inbox/teams.py:457 total = len(record.modules), which holds CP-MODEL, while activity.module_states never lists it.
probe: found by repair-1's T02 review (2026-11-17); the T02 test is the probe
suggested_change: Leave the forecast code out of progress's total.

screen: #/model/:issuer/:run/* for a run whose model delivers one case
title: A model run that delivers one case instead of two is refused whole by the Model reader ('expected two cases'), so none of its pages can be read.
expected: A missing or partial part of a run is stated as a gap, not a reason to hide the run (D-14; S5-001's repair for a run with no forecast).
actual: web/src/pages/model/slice/read.ts:302 refuses a run whose forecast has other than two cases; the Model pages compare two cases by design.
suggested_change: none: the owner decides whether a one-case model is shown with a stated gap or stays refused

screen: /connected/snapshot and run activity issues, a run with a locked or unreadable file
title: The issuer library's issue text keeps the first 80 characters of an OSError's message, which hold the server's absolute path, and those issues reach run activity and /connected/snapshot.
expected: README ruling R3: a leaked path is always repaired (the same class as R1-001).
actual: apps/issuer-library/credit_os/store.py:600,1167,1319 and evidence.py:45,116 write describe(error), the type plus str(error)[:80] (source.py:264-268), into issues.
probe: found by repair-1's T01 review (2026-11-17), shown by a direct call on a PermissionError; the T01 follow-up test is the probe
suggested_change: describe() names an OSError by its type (and a run-relative name), never an absolute path.

title: A data.js with no final ';' makes the service answer 500.
